description: Objective Root — what outcome is sought, how uncertain is that interpretation?

CARE.example: help Arif with Telegram session seal architecture

objective_contract.task_type: enum — one of the 5 types above
objective_contract.success_metric: string — how reality tells us we succeeded
falsification_criteria: list of conditions that would make this session fail
constraints: list of safety limits, reversibility, blast radius
objective_contract.rollback_procedure: string — what to do if session fails
